name: io.github.arhancanli/canli-mcp
title: Canli Capital
description: 345 finance tools, 56 prompts: quant, SEC and EU filings, fact checks, rates, odds, DeFi, macro.

environmentVariables.name: CANLI_PACKS
environmentVariables.description: Packs to enable, comma-separated (quant, validation, fundamentals, research, backtest, markets, paper) or all. Default: all but paper.

environmentVariables.name: CANLI_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: 1 enables only the packs that never use the network (quant, validation).

environmentVariables.name: ALPACA_PAPER_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Alpaca paper key id (starts PK); enables the paper pack.
